The '''Corellia public archives''' was located on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Here research could be done on recent [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] news and society via [[Computer/Legends|computer]]. The archives also held information on surnames. As a boy, [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] came here to look up his last name in the historical records.
